name: Stress
overview: Scripture reveals that stress and worry are burdens best cast upon the Lord, who sustains and strengthens His people in times of distress, as seen in Psalms 55:22 and Psalms 118:5. Believers are encouraged to be courageous and unafraid because God is always with them (Joshua 1:9). The Bible also highlights the futility of anxious thoughts, reminding us that worry cannot add to our stature (Matthew 6:27) and calls us to prioritize seeking God's kingdom, promising that our needs will be met (Matthew 6:33). Furthermore, a kind word can uplift a heavy heart, offering comfort amid stress (Proverbs 12:25).
